scope: Native non-LOCK byte-memory AND for the measured hrtimer path. Central translation guard preserves LOCK atomicity by retaining interpreter execution except for CMPXCHG, which has an atomic native callback.
validation: 111 JIT tests pass across both tiers. Includes register/address aliasing, full-state/memory parity, declined reads, rejected writes after successful reads, unchanged memory and flags on fault, and LOCK AND/ADD/INC declining before memory side effects. Existing atomic CMPXCHG tests pass.
cleanup: Removed a default-cache-size equality test that did not exercise the working-set behavior its name claimed. Existing cache wrap and lookup behavior tests remain.
limitation: Exact changed files in isolated qualification checkout; current live production runner predates this patch. No boot speedup claim.
